title: Bochi Totem
description: Replaces the Totem of Undying texture with an animated Bocchi the Rock! fan-made animation. Free to use!
body:
Bocchi the Rock! - Totem of Undying
Replaces the Totem of Undying texture with an animated Bocchi the Rock! character.
Features:

Animated texture (6 frames)
Transparent background
Available for Minecraft 26.1.x and 1.21.x


Fan-made, not affiliated with CloverWorks. Free to use.
